data.text: Abbreviations: CRF = case report form; CRU = clinical research unit; EOS = End of Study; SoA = Schedule of Activities.
Rescreened participants are not required to reconsent as long as they have signed the latest version of the ICF.

If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed. This review of the ECG printed at the time of collection must be documented.

Triplicate 12_lead ECGs will be conducted as outlined in the SoA (see Section 1.3) to obtain heart rate, PR, QRS, QT, and QTc intervals. As with vital signs, if ECG interval measurements are abnormal, an additional triplicate will be performed and recorded in the CRF.

Blood pressure and heart rate measurements should be preceded by at least 5 minutes of rest for the participant in a quiet setting without distractions (eg, television, cell phones). Ideally, the same arm for each participant should be used for measurements.

If vital signs are abnormal as defined by inclusion/exclusion criteria, 2 additional vital signs measurements will be made. The average of the 3 vital signs measurements will be recorded in the CRF and used to determine participant eligibility.

All laboratory tests with values considered abnormal and clinically significant during participation in the study or after the last dose of study intervention should be repeated until the values return to normal or baseline or are no longer considered clinically significant by the Investigator or Medical Monitor.

All SAEs will be recorded and reported to Alexion or the designee immediately and under no circumstance should this exceed 24 hours, as indicated in Section 10.3. The Investigator will submit any updated SAE data to Alexion within 24 hours of it being available.

However, if the Investigator learns of any SAE, including a death, at any time after a participant has been discharged from the study, and he/she considers the event to be reasonably related to the study intervention or study participation, the Investigator must promptly notify Alexion.

data.text: A single biobanked serum sample will be collected predose from each participant to serve as a retained sample during the study. Samples will remain on site and will be discarded following the completion of the clinical study report. The sample will not be used for genetic testing.

For this study, any dose of ALXN1840 greater than that specified in the protocol will be considered an overdose. Alexion does not recommend specific treatment for an overdose. Overdoses are medication errors that are not considered AEs unless there is an untoward medical occurrence resulting from the overdose.
Samples collected within ± 10% or 30 min, whichever is less, of the scheduled time will not be considered a protocol deviation.

Excess/additional samples may be stored for up to 5 years and used for PD and/or diagnostic biomarker development and research to understand the pathways associated with the mechanism of action of ALXN1840. These samples will not be used for genetic analyses (ie, RNA or DNA analyses).
As this study is an exploratory study, no formal hypothesis testing is being conducted. Study results will be summarized using descriptive statistics.
Medical Monitor Name and Contact Information can be found in the Study Contact List.

footnotes: a. Within 42 days of ALXN1840 administration. Details of procedures that may be performed by sites designated as "screening sites" (only in the US) are detailed in Section 8.
b. Participants will be admitted to the clinical research unit (CRU) at least 10 hours prior to enrollment and initiation of copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet.
c. At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU or be readmitted on Day 22 with all procedures starting on Day 23.
d. Unscheduled study visits may occur at any time during the study and may include any study procedure as deemed necessary by the Investigator.
e. Participants are required to return to the CRU Day 54+/_2; participants will be discontinued from ALXN1840 medication by their physician at the latest by the Day 54 follow_up.

f. Discharge from the unit may occur after completion of all procedures on Day 9 and on Day 40 and after the Investigator has reviewed all safety assessment (including safety laboratory tests) and confirmed that the participant is appropriate for discharge.

g. A single outpatient visit or phone call and safety laboratory assessment should occur between Day 14 and Day 18. A phone call may take place on a different day than the blood draw within the Day 14 through Day 18 period.
h. If needed to confirm menopause.
i. Parameters include age and sex. Race and ethnicity will be collected where permitted by local regulations.
j. Wilson disease history will include diagnosis date, method of diagnosis, history of cirrhosis, details of any previous liver biopsies performed, and treatment received.

k. A full physical examination will be performed at Screening, at check_in for the study, and at the End of the study/Early Termination Visit. A physical examination should also be performed on any participants with ongoing adverse events prior to discharge from the unit. Otherwise, a symptom_driven physical examination may be performed at other times, at the Principal Investigator's discretion.
l. Height at screening only.

m. While in the CRU, study intervention will be administered after an overnight fast (ie, at least 10 hours) at the same time every morning; drug is to be administered with 240 mL of water and meals should be delayed a minimum of 2 hours after dosing. As an outpatient, participants are expected to take ALXN1840 at approximately the same time daily (+/_1 hour). Participants should take the medication with a glass of water on an empty stomach; meals should be delayed a minimum of 2 hours after dosing.
n. During the outpatient period, participants will use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.
o. Blood sampling for PK/PD will occur before ALXN1840 administration and represents a predose trough. See Table 2 for PK/PD sampling on Days 1, 25, 29, and 39.
p. PK/PD collection will include timepoints described in the schedule of PK/PD assessment for Days 1, 25, 29, and 39 (Table 2).

q. Samples for serum chemistry will be obtained following a fast of at least 8 hours at the Screening Visit and at check_in. In case of rechecks, and postdose serum chemistry, participants may not have fasted for 6 or 8 hours before the serum chemistry sample is taken.
r. Laboratory assessment including chemistry, hematology, and coagulation parameters should be performed on Days _8, _1, 8, 23, and 28 only.

s. Menstruation check for women only; women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening. Additional urine pregnancy testing will be standard for the protocol unless serum testing is required by site policies, local regulation, or Institutional Review Boards (IRBs)/Independent Ethics Committees (IECs) (Section 10.2). In addition to pregnancy tests detailed at the visits in the SoA, females of childbearing potential will be required to perform urine pregnancy tests at least every 4 weeks at their home or the study site throughout their time in the study.
t. A single 15 mL serum sample will be retained for evaluation in the event of an unexpected safety finding; retained samples may be destroyed after completion of the clinical study report.

u. Vital signs measurements and ECGs should be performed predose, unless otherwise specified. Vitals signs include body temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, and systolic and diastolic blood pressure.

v. Copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet will be initiated after registration/inclusion. Participants will remain on a copper/molybdenum controlled diet throughout both the inpatient Period 1 (Day _8 to Day 9) and inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40); during this time participants will be strongly encouraged to complete all meals. While not in the CRU, participants will be encouraged to adhere to their usual copper_controlled diet.
w. For each input/output balance period, 24_hour urine samples are to be collected for measurement of copper and molybdenum.
x. For fecal samples, each individual sample will be independently collected with record of date, time, and weight of the sample.

data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Participants aged ≥18 at the time of signing the ICF.

data.name: Wilson Disease diagnosis
data.text: Diagnosis of WD by Leipzig Criteria ≥ 4 documented by testing as outlined in the 2012 European Association for the Study of Liver WD Clinical Practice Guidelines (Ferenci, 2003; EASL, 2012) or by historical test results for WD including some or all of the following: Presence of Kayser Fleischer rings, Neurological symptoms, Serum ceruloplasmin below reference range, Coombs_negative hemolytic anemia, Elevated liver or urinary copper, Presence of mutations in the ATP7B gene, or Other, as considered appropriate, may be used instead to confirm the diagnosis of WD.

data.name: Ability to reside in CRU
data.text: Participants must be able to reside in the CRU for intensive metabolic monitoring of copper and molybdenum.

data.name: Willingness to discontinue chelator therapy
data.text: Participants willing to discontinue chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiation of ALXN1840 to allow a baseline assessment of copper balance.

data.name: Willingness to avoid copper/zinc/molybdenum minerals

data.name: Willingness to adhere to controlled diet

data.name: Contraceptive use requirement
data.text: Contraceptive use by men or women should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. Male participants: Male participants, if heterosexually active and with a female spouse or partner of childbearing potential or a pregnant or breastfeeding spouse or partner, must agree to use barrier contraception (male condom) for the duration of the study and for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Male participants must not donate sperm for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female spouses or partners of male participants who are of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception as defined in Section 10.4, starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before (the male participant's) first study intervention administration and continuing until at least 3 months after the end of their male partner's systemic exposure to the study intervention. Barrier contraception (male condom) is required even with documented medical assessment of surgical success of a vasectomy. For male participants who have had a vasectomy (with documented evidence of azoospermia if possible) and agree to use a male condom for the stated time period, no additional contraceptive method is required by their female partner. Female participants: Female participants or female partners of male participants of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding females), if heterosexually active, must be willing to follow protocol_specified contraception guidance starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before first study intervention administration and continuing for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants must not donate ova for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants who are documented as being of non_childbearing potential as defined in Section 10.4 are exempt from contraception requirements.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Participants capable of giving signed informed consent, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Decompensated cirrhosis or high MELD score
data.text: Decompensated cirrhosis or model for end_stage liver disease (MELD) score > 13.

data.name: High modified Nazer score
data.text: Modified Nazer score > 7 (Dhawan, 2005).

data.name: Recent gastrointestinal bleed
data.text: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed within past 3 months.

data.name: Elevated ALT
data.text: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) > 2 × upper limit of normal (ULN).

data.name: Marked neurological disease
data.text: Marked neurological disease requiring assistance with self_care or activities of daily life.

data.name: Low hemoglobin
data.text: Hemoglobin less than lower limit of the reference range for age and sex.

data.name: Active viral infection or HIV seropositivity
data.text: Active infection with hepatitis B virus (positive hepatitis B surface antigen) or C virus (participants with positive hepatitis C antibody result would require confirmation of active disease with a positive hepatitis C polymerase chain reaction test), or seropositivity for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

data.name: Significant medical history or current disorder
data.text: History or presence of/significant history of or current cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrinological, hematological, or neurological disorders, or psychiatric disorder that in the opinion of the Investigator may constitute a risk when taking the study intervention; or may interfere with the interpretation of data.

data.name: Prior ALXN1840 or tetrathiomolybdate treatment
data.text: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing.

data.name: Prior zinc treatment
data.text: Previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1.

data.name: Recent experimental or unapproved therapy
data.text: The use of an experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy at the same time or within 90 days or 5 half_lives, whichever is longer, prior to the Screening Visit.

data.name: Renal failure
data.text: Participants in renal failure, defined as in end_stage renal disease on dialysis (chronic kidney disease [CKD] stage 5) or creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min (Levey, 2006).

data.name: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
data.text: Pregnant (or females who are planning to become pregnant) or breastfeeding females (women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum pregnancy test result at screening).

data.name: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840 or excipients
data.text: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840, ALXN1840 excipients (anhydrous dicalcium phosphate, anhydrous sodium carbonate), or any of the ingredients contained in ALXN1840 or related compounds.

data.name: Likely non_compliance
data.text: In the opinion of the Investigator, the participant and/or their legal guardian is likely to be non_compliant or uncooperative during the study.

data.name: History of illicit drug or significant alcohol abuse
data.text: History of illicit drug abuse, history of significant alcohol abuse within 1 year prior to the Screening Visit, or clinical evidence of substance and/or alcohol abuse within the 2 years before screening. Alcohol abuse is defined as regular weekly intake of more than 14 units (for both males and females), using the following National Health Service (NHS) alcohol tracker http://www.nhs.uk/Tools/Pages/drinks_tracker.aspx.

data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day _8 (cannabinoids will not be tested).

data.name: Recent alcohol consumption or positive alcohol breath test
data.text: Alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day _8.

data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study.

Eligibility and Registration Condition
data.description: Enrollment definition requiring signed ICF, eligibility, and registration
data.text: "Enrolled" means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day _7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee must review available safety data before up_titration to 30 mg/day
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concern Precluding Dose Escalation
data.description: Participants remain at 15 mg/day if escalation poses undue risk
data.text: Dosing will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Zinc Washout Condition
data.description: Participants must be off zinc for at least 21 days before first dose to prevent confounding of fecal copper excretion
data.text: To prevent confounding of the study results, participants must be off zinc therapy for a minimum of 21 days prior to Day 1; the inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 21 days after discontinuation of zinc.

data.name: Chelator Discontinuation for Baseline Copper Assessment
data.description: Chelator therapy stopped approximately 4 days prior to ALXN1840 initiation during Inpatient Run_in Period
data.text: To assess the copper baseline during the Inpatient Run_in Period, participants will be discontinued from their chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiating ALXN1840, while maintained on a copper_controlled diet.

data.name: Negative Pregnancy Test Condition
data.description: Women of childbearing potential may only be enrolled after negative serum pregnancy test
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening; additional urine pregnancy testing at least every 4 weeks throughout the study.

data.name: Negative Drug/Alcohol Screen Condition
data.description: Positive urine drug toxicology or alcohol breath test at Screening or Day _8 excludes participant
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day _8 (cannabinoids will not be tested); alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day _8.

data.name: Dietary Compliance Condition
data.description: Willingness to complete every meal and tolerate controlled menu
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study are excluded. Participants remain on copper/molybdenum controlled diet throughout Inpatient Period 1 (Day _8 to Day 9) and Inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40).

data.name: Neutrophil Decline Dose Modification Condition
data.description: Hematologic criterion triggering dose reduction
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up_titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hepatic Injury Dose Modification Condition
data.description: Bilirubin and ALT criterion indicative of liver injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840, weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Condition
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or neurologic physical exam
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Condition
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but is not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification.

data.name: Rechallenge Conditions
data.description: Limits and requirements for rechallenge after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Rechallenge after hepatic interruption occurs at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN and requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose.

data.name: Adaptive Design Condition
data.description: Adaptive features may be implemented at Investigator discretion without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Outpatient Period extension requires Investigator approval and provision of additional drug
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. Participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing; the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Continued Inpatient Stay Condition
data.description: Participants may remain in CRU instead of discharge at Day 9
data.text: At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding Condition
data.description: Investigator review determines continuation after clinically significant finding
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up Condition
data.description: Definition and contact attempts required before declaring lost to follow_up
data.text: A participant will be considered lost to follow_up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site. Before a participant is deemed lost to follow_up, the Investigator or designee must make every effort to regain contact (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter to the participant's last known mailing address).

data.name: Concomitant Medication Dose Limits
data.description: Limits on allowed analgesics
data.text: Paracetamol/acetaminophen at doses of a maximum 1000 mg per day is permitted with Investigator approval. Ibuprofen dose must not exceed 1200 mg in any 24_hour period and may only be used with approval of the Investigator.

data.name: Screening to Run_in/Enrollment Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled on Day _7 (admitted to the CRU on Day _8) and initiated on a copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet after registration/inclusion; participants must sign ICF, be eligible, and be registered/assigned a participant number.

data.name: Run_in Period to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run_in Period (diet equilibration Day _7 to Day _5 and baseline copper/molybdenum balance collection Day _4 to Day _1), participants will be administered ALXN1840 at 15 mg/day starting on Day 1. Participants must be off zinc ≥ 21 days and off chelator approximately 4 days prior to Day 1.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9 or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain integrity of study conduct. During the Outpatient Period, participants use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who were discharged will be re_admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose) for Treatment Period 2; all procedures will start on Day 23 and participants remain in house until Day 40. If the Outpatient Period is extended (up to 14 additional days with Investigator approval), the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Titration from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: Participants will be administered ALXN1840 15 mg/day on Day 1 through Day 28 and then increase to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, after SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant, unless safety concerns preclude escalation.

data.name: Dose Reduction for Hematologic Abnormality
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils with baseline neutrophils below reference range: reduce dose to previous dose level if up_titration has occurred, or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality, with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hepatic Abnormality
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN indicative of liver injury requires temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN, requiring Alexion Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurological or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes it is in the best interest of the participant.

data.name: Mandatory Consideration for Study Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary for the participant.

data.name: Remain in Study for Safety Follow_up After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow_up, per the Schedule of Activities.

data.name: End of Treatment to End of Study Visit Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods of the study (ie, Day 40), participants transition to previously discontinued therapy, other standard of care therapy, or (at treating physician discretion) continued ALXN1840 under preapproval access; all participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/_ 2 days).

data.name: Participant Withdrawal From Study
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons; the participant will be permanently discontinued both from study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Post_Study Therapy Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (Day 40), participants will transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or request continuation of ALXN1840 under local preapproval access regulations.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (EOS Visit on Day 54 +/_ 2 days). The end of the study is defined as the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (End of Study/Early Termination Visit, including full physical examination) should be conducted as shown in the SoA; participant is permanently discontinued from study intervention and the study.

data.name: Withdrawal of Consent
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request. If the participant withdraws consent for disclosure of future information, Alexion may retain and continue to use any data collected before such withdrawal; the participant may request destruction of any samples taken and not tested.

data.name: Investigator_Initiated Withdrawal
data.description: Participant may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons.

data.name: Lost to Follow_up
data.description: Should the participant continue to be unreachable after 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter, he/she will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Safety_Related Discontinuation
data.description: Serious hypersensitivity reaction, severe uncontrolled infection, or other safety events deemed necessary by Alexion or the Investigator lead to discontinuation of study intervention.

data.name: Protocol Deviation _ Use of Disallowed Medication
data.description: Use of disallowed medication (prescription medications within 14 days or 5 half_lives of Day _7, nonprescription drugs/supplements within 7 days or 5 half_lives before Day _7) requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason, including Investigator noncompliance with the protocol/IRB/IEC/GCP requirements, inadequate recruitment, or discontinuation of further study intervention development. A study site is considered closed when all participants have completed the end of study or early discontinuation visit.

data.name: SRC Safety Review and Dose Titration Decision
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the Safety Review Committee reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant; if safety concerns exist, the participant may remain on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study.

data.name: CRU Discharge Decision
data.description: Decision at Day 9 whether the participant is discharged to the Outpatient Period or remains in the CRU for safety or to maintain integrity of study conduct.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: Investigator decides whether to extend the Outpatient Period up to an additional 14 days, providing additional investigational product; participant then continues Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Safety Laboratory Dose Modification Decision
data.description: Decision point at scheduled safety laboratory assessments (Days _8, _1, 8, 23, 28) and weekly repeat testing to reduce, interrupt, restrict increase, or rechallenge ALXN1840 dosing per Table 7 criteria.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Assessment Dose Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor evaluate need for dose modification based on copper control parameters and clinical data; rationale documented and re_evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Eligibility/Enrollment Decision at Day _7
data.description: Participants who sign ICF and are eligible are registered on Day _7 and assigned a participant number, and initiated on the copper_ and molybdenum_controlled diet.

data.name: Post_Study Intervention Decision
data.description: Following completion of both inpatient periods, decision whether the participant resumes pre_enrollment therapy, starts other standard of care therapy, or requests continued ALXN1840 under preapproval access.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG Finding Continuation Decision
data.description: Investigator or qualified designee determines if the participant can continue in the study and whether change in management is needed after identification of a clinically significant ECG/QTcF finding.
